name: Gletscherblick B&B
beschreibung: Gletscherblick B&B in Ischgl is quietly located at the entrance to the village, near the valley station of the Silvrettabahn. It is classified as an inn and offers rooms and apartments with a view of the Silvretta-Gletscher. The breakfast buffet is served daily and includes regional products. After a day of skiing, guests can use the wellness area with sauna, steam bath, and infrared cabin. The ski bus stops directly in front of the house and goes to the Silvrettabahn. The accommodation has a sun terrace and a garden with a lawn for sunbathing. The furnishings of the rooms combine traditional wood details with modern comfort. In summer, the surrounding area is ideal for hiking and mountain bike tours.
